classifications.rationale: The President immediately designates and withdraws federal land (self-executing legal effects), while also requiring the Secretary to impose a later off-road vehicle prohibition and assigning ongoing monument management. These materially different postures are inseparably bundled in the segment.
classifications.evidence: All Federal lands and interests in lands within the boundaries of this monument are hereby appropriated and withdrawn from all forms of entry, location, selection, sale, or leasing or other disposition under the public land laws

classifications.rationale: The segment directs the Secretary to prepare a transportation plan, an internal planning duty, while also immediately qualifying the monument's establishment by preserving valid existing rights. Those distinct postures are combined in one segment.
classifications.evidence: The establishment of this monument is subject to valid existing rights.
